name: agent-lolo
description: Local-first AI coding agent for small local models (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio): chat, plan & edit with diff approvals, checkpoints, inline edit, autocomplete. Nothing leaves your machine.

localAgent.endpoint.description: Ollama base URL, or OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in /v1.

localAgent.model.description: Model for chat and agent runs (also selectable in the chat). qwen3.5:9b is more accurate if you have ~8 GB of VRAM.

localAgent.profiles.description: Model profile overrides. Each item needs `match` (model id prefix) plus any ModelProfile fields.

localAgent.autoApproveEdits.description: Apply edits without diff review (a checkpoint is still taken).

localAgent.autoRunCommands.description: Start the chat in "Run everything" mode: edits and terminal commands run without asking. Dangerous commands (rm -rf, sudo, git push --force, ...) are always blocked, and a checkpoint is taken before each run.

localAgent.commandAllowlist.description: Command prefixes run_command may execute without asking.

localAgent.embeddingModel.markdownDescription: Embedding model for semantic code search (e.g. `nomic-embed-text`: `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`). Empty: off. The index is kept in `.agent/index`.

enumDescriptions: Your own SearXNG instance (local-first; set localAgent.web.searxngUrl)
Brave Search API (API key: "Agent Lolo: Set Web Search API Key")
Tavily API (API key: "Agent Lolo: Set Web Search API Key")
DuckDuckGo's HTML page (no key; may rate-limit)
localAgent.web.search.markdownDescription: Lets the agent search the web and read pages when you ask for it (`@web`, a URL, "latest version"). Every query and page download is shown for approval first.

localAgent.web.searxngUrl.markdownDescription: SearXNG base URL, e.g. `http://localhost:8080`. The instance must allow the `json` output format.

localAgent.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers, e.g. `{"github": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"], "env": {"GITHUB_TOKEN": "${env:GITHUB_TOKEN}"}}}` or `{"docs": {"url": "https://example.com/mcp"}}`. Also read from `.agent/mcp.json` and `.vscode/mcp.json`. Optional `tools: [...]` limits which tools are offered. Tools are offered only when a task is about them (or you write `@mcp:<server>`), and calls ask for approval unless the server marks the tool read-only.

localAgent.maxStepsPerTodo.description: Steps per todo. While edits keep applying, a todo may take up to 3× this.

localAgent.claudeHooks.markdownDescription: Run Claude Code hooks (`hooks` in `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `~/.claude/settings.json`): `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`. Only in trusted workspaces.

localAgent.reviewPlan.description: Stop for plan review (edit/drop steps) before every Agent run. Off by default: use Plan mode to review a plan, then Run this plan.

localAgent.autocomplete.enabled.description: Inline (ghost text) completions via the model's FIM tokens.

localAgent.autocomplete.model.description: Model for autocomplete (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, much faster on CPU). Empty: use localAgent.model.

scripts.package: node esbuild.mjs --production && vite build --logLevel warn && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
